use_cases.title: Weekly campaign performance brief
use_cases.situation: Every Monday leadership expects a summary of last week's website and ad performance. Collecting numbers from several dashboards takes hours and the written summary is often rushed.
workflow_steps: Export last week's key metrics from GA4 and Google Ads into one sheet.
Give the assistant the numbers and ask it to list the biggest changes against the previous week and any unusual spikes or drops.
Ask it to draft a short summary in plain language for non-technical readers.
Check every figure against the source dashboards and correct anything wrong.
Add your own recommendations and send.
use_cases.result: Reporting becomes faster and more consistent, leaving more time for decisions.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Offer a recurring "weekly insights brief" to small business clients.
guardrails: Verify all numbers manually against primary source dashboards before distribution.
Do not share confidential, personal or client-identifiable data with any AI or cloud tool without explicit permission and an approved enterprise data policy.
practice_skills: Reading GA4 acquisition and event reports
Writing clear data analysis prompts
Basic spreadsheet validation checks

use_cases.title: Lead follow-up automation for a small client
use_cases.situation: A small business receives enquiries through a website form but follows up late and inconsistently.
workflow_steps: A form submission on the WordPress site triggers an automation in Zapier.
The contact is added to the CRM with the right tag and category.
A generative AI tool drafts a personalised reply based on the enquiry.
The draft is sent to the owner for review and approval before it goes out.
A follow-up reminder is scheduled if there is no reply within three business days.
use_cases.result: Faster and more consistent follow-up, with the owner staying in control.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Package it as a fixed-scope "enquiry follow-up setup" for clients.
guardrails: Get explicit consent for storing contact data under applicable privacy laws.
Always maintain human review and approval before sending external client communications.
practice_skills: Automation triggers and actions in Zapier
CRM contact property basics
Writing prompt templates with dynamic variables

use_cases.title: Multichannel content repurposing workflow
use_cases.situation: The team writes thorough monthly articles on the corporate blog, but lacks the editorial bandwidth to break each piece down into newsletter snippets, social posts, and visual carousels.
workflow_steps: Copy the finalized blog post text from WordPress into Claude.
Prompt the assistant to extract five core takeaways and draft three distinct social post angles with appropriate line breaks.
Review the generated drafts against brand editorial standards and refine the tone.
Import approved headline snippets into Canva layout templates to format visual cards.
Schedule the approved posts and graphics inside Meta Business Suite across target channels.
use_cases.result: Editorial output extends across multiple platforms with consistent brand messaging.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Offer a "blog-to-social repurposing package" to founders and busy marketing teams on a monthly retainer.
guardrails: Review every post manually for accurate factual context and appropriate tone.
Ensure no proprietary internal strategic plans are pasted into unapproved tools.
practice_skills: Structuring long-form text for extraction
Consistent brand voice editing
Social graphic layout assembly in Canva

use_cases.title: Paid search ad copy variant generation and verification
use_cases.situation: Search campaigns require dozens of character-limited headlines and descriptions to improve ad relevance, but brainstorming variations manually is tedious and prone to formatting errors.
workflow_steps: Identify target commercial search queries and search intent terms using Semrush.
Prompt the generative assistant to write 15 headlines (under 30 characters) and 4 descriptions (under 90 characters) targeting those exact intents.
Run an automated character count check in a spreadsheet to ensure zero truncation.
Check each variation for compliance with Google Ads editorial policies and brand voice guidelines.
Upload the approved responsive search ad assets directly into Google Ads campaign groups.
use_cases.result: Faster creation of structured ad variants that adhere strictly to platform constraints.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Offer an "ad copy refresh and intent alignment" sprint for small ecommerce accounts.
guardrails: Strictly verify character count limits before uploading.
Never make unsubstantiated claims or misleading guarantees in ad copy.
practice_skills: Search intent analysis in Semrush
Writing prompt constraints with character length limits
Responsive search ad structuring in Google Ads

use_cases.title: Automated churn-risk customer reactivation journey
use_cases.situation: Subscribers who stop opening weekly product announcements are at risk of lapsing, but generic email blasts fail to re-engage them.
workflow_steps: Define an inactive segment criteria in Braze based on last login and open milestones.
Draft three differentiated re-engagement messages tailored to recent browsing categories using an assistant.
Set up an automated journey in Make to sync updated user preference flags between the database and Braze.
Subject the draft copy to internal team review and run a proof test send to internal seed addresses.
Launch the automated reactivation branch with holdout control groups to measure real engagement lift.
use_cases.result: Lapsed users receive timely, relevant messaging without requiring manual campaign intervention.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Consult for growth startups to design and configure their dormant user reactivation flows.
guardrails: Verify all opt-out and unsubscribe links function seamlessly according to anti-spam regulations.
Ensure user segments contain no unhashed personal identifiers during webhook transfers.
practice_skills: Audience lifecycle segmentation in Braze
Constructing webhook branches in Make
Design of holdout testing methodologies

use_cases.title: Social media creative asset batching and localized variations
use_cases.situation: A regional business wants weekly social graphics tailored to three local markets, but creating each visual independently is time-consuming.
workflow_steps: Use Midjourney to create stylized, royalty-free background textures matching the client's brand palette.
Prompt a generative tool to adapt one master promotional message into three regional localized phrases.
Review the regional terms with the client to verify local relevance and cultural appropriateness.
Batch create the visual banners using Canva's template bulk-create features.
Package the finished creative files into organized cloud folders with suggested publication dates.
use_cases.result: Streamlined asset production allowing consistent regional presence without excessive production time.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Offer multi-market "monthly visual batching" retainers to regional hospitality and retail businesses.
guardrails: Ensure all generated imagery conforms to commercial usage guidelines.
Have the client explicitly approve localized wording prior to any public release.
practice_skills: Generating consistent visual textures
Canva bulk-creation workflows
Client asset organization and handoff standards

use_cases.title: Competitive keyword gap and content brief generator
use_cases.situation: Prospective clients ask where their organic search presence is falling behind competitors, but conducting keyword gap research manually takes several days per audit.
workflow_steps: Export the keyword overlap and gap report between the client and their top three competitors from Semrush.
Feed the raw keyword terms and search volumes into Claude with instructions to cluster them into logical topic clusters.
Have the model outline a 5-part content pillar brief highlighting missing search intent angles.
Verify search volumes and competitiveness manually in Semrush to ensure achievable ranking targets.
Format the approved content outline as an editorial roadmap for the client's WordPress publication calendar.
use_cases.result: Faster audit turnaround that provides prospective clients with a clear, intent-grounded editorial roadmap.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Sell standalone "Competitive SEO & Content Gap Audits" as an entry point for agency client acquisition.
guardrails: Manually double-check search difficulty metrics before promising client outcomes.
Do not paste private client contract details or proprietary company metrics into the assistant.
practice_skills: Semrush keyword gap extraction
Prompting language models to cluster semantic search data
Formatting actionable editorial briefs

use_cases.title: Omnichannel onboarding trigger and messaging sync
use_cases.situation: New users sign up on the website but often miss critical setup milestones because onboarding emails and website live-chat prompts operate independently.
workflow_steps: Map key milestone events in the customer onboarding journey inside HubSpot.
Build a Zapier webhook that triggers when a user has been registered for 48 hours without completing step two.
Trigger a contextual, helpful conversation prompt via Freshchat when the user next visits the portal.
Test the trigger sequence across test accounts to confirm no duplicate messages are dispatched.
Review conversation logs weekly to identify where users still experience friction.
use_cases.result: Coordinated messaging across email and web chat that guides users through initial setup without confusion.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Package this as an "onboarding flow audit and sync" for B2B SaaS and service companies.
guardrails: Include rate-limiting rules so users are never bombarded across multiple channels simultaneously.
Keep human support agents accessible if an automated prompt fails to resolve the user's issue.
practice_skills: Event tracking and webhook payload inspection
Conditional branching in Zapier
Live-chat conversation routing rules

use_cases.title: Autonomous customer feedback sentiment categorization and ticketing
use_cases.situation: Hundreds of post-campaign survey responses arrive every month. Reading and tagging each response manually creates a backlog, delaying urgent customer follow-ups.
workflow_steps: Connect survey form submissions to a Make scenario that triggers on new entry.
Route the qualitative response text through a Relevance AI agent with strict tagging rules (Product, Billing, Campaign, Sentiment).
If negative sentiment or an urgent issue is detected, create a high-priority follow-up ticket in HubSpot.
Store the classified metadata in a shared spreadsheet for weekly trend analysis.
Have an operations coordinator audit a 10% sample of categorized tickets weekly for classification accuracy.
use_cases.result: Urgent customer feedback surfaces quickly while general feedback trends are structured automatically.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Implement automated feedback-triage systems for customer success and marketing operations teams.
guardrails: Enforce strict human sampling to detect automated misclassifications early.
Anonymize feedback text so personal contact details are not passed to third-party endpoints unnecessarily.
practice_skills: Configuring AI agent task instructions
Error handling and fallback routes in Make
CRM ticket property automation

use_cases.title: Client pitch and market positioning tear-sheet
use_cases.situation: Before a prospective client call, the consultant needs to understand the prospect's brand voice, core competitors, and current digital marketing footprint in under an hour.
workflow_steps: Extract public search metrics and top traffic drivers for the prospect's website using Semrush.
Feed public website copy and recent company announcements into Gemini to identify their stated target audience and positioning tone.
Draft three specific discussion topics where digital execution could be strengthened.
Assemble the verified notes into a clean, one-page tear-sheet using a standard Canva template.
Review the notes before the call and use them to guide the client discovery conversation.
use_cases.result: Consultant arrives prepared with tailored talking points that immediately demonstrate understanding of the client's business.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Use this workflow as standard pre-call preparation to elevate close rates on discovery calls.
guardrails: Rely only on verified public information; do not present speculative assertions as facts.
Keep the focus on asking perceptive questions rather than declaring premature solutions.
practice_skills: Rapid competitive domain analysis
Synthesizing qualitative brand positioning
Creating one-page executive summaries in Canva

use_cases.title: In-email interactive survey and lead capture
use_cases.situation: Prospective clients and trial users often abandon external survey and feedback forms when redirected away from their email inbox. Marketing needs a seamless way to collect feedback and schedule demos without friction.
workflow_steps: Define the feedback or demo request questions and identify the target segment in HubSpot.
Use ChatGPT to draft engaging, concise email invitation copy and subject line alternatives.
Build an interactive AMP email template in Mailmodo allowing the recipient to fill the form directly inside the email body.
Set up an automated webhook connection to synchronize form responses directly into HubSpot customer records.
Send test emails across desktop and mobile clients to inspect rendering and verify AMP fallbacks.
Review live response rates in Mailmodo and monitor landing page referral traffic in GA4.
use_cases.result: Higher submission rates and fewer manual steps by eliminating unnecessary external page redirects, while keeping customer data organized.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Offer clients a turnkey "Interactive Email Lead Generation & Survey" setup service.
guardrails: Send test emails to internal team members to verify rendering across multiple email providers before broad broadcast.
Ensure all recipient addresses have verified opt-in consent and conform to data protection regulations before syncing with third-party tools.
practice_skills: Designing AMP email templates with fallback HTML
Configuring webhooks between email platforms and CRM systems
Interpreting email interaction and conversion rates

use_cases.title: Landing page user behavior and conversion audit
use_cases.situation: A paid advertising campaign is driving visitors to a product page, but users drop off before requesting a consultation. The marketing team needs to diagnose page friction points and refine the layout.
workflow_steps: Review GA4 traffic acquisition reports to identify which channels and devices show the highest bounce rates.
Examine Hotjar heatmaps and session recordings on the target page to spot where visitors hesitate, scroll past, or exit.
Run a crawl audit using Moz Pro to check for technical issues, slow-loading assets, or missing meta elements.
Summarize user friction points and prompt ChatGPT to brainstorm copy refinements and clear call-to-action placements.
Collaborate with the design team to build an updated page variant addressing the observed drop-off areas.
Audit all proposed changes for clarity, brand tone, and mobile responsiveness before publishing.
use_cases.result: Clear qualitative understanding of visitor behavior and systematic, data-guided landing page refinements.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Package this process as a standardized "Landing Page CRO & UX Diagnostic Audit" for freelance clients.
guardrails: Enable keystroke and sensitive input masking in Hotjar so personal user entries are never captured.
Verify all visual insights against primary analytics before making substantial structural web modifications.
practice_skills: Analyzing website heatmaps and session recordings
Diagnosing funnel drop-off stages in GA4
Formulating structured page optimization recommendations

Export key week-over-week metric variances into a structured table.
Prompt the assistant to generate a 3-bullet executive briefing highlighting top positive and negative outliers.
Verify all generated figures and percentages against the primary dashboard visualizations.
Add analyst commentary regarding operational context and deliver to stakeholders.
use_cases.result: Faster report generation with standardized formatting and validated quantitative figures.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Offer small business owners a recurring "Monthly BI Dashboard & Insights Digest" service.
guardrails: Double-check all AI-generated summary figures against primary data warehouse queries before sending.
Never paste unaggregated customer records or confidential proprietary data into cloud AI tools.
practice_skills: Building scheduled dashboard extracts
Crafting data verification prompt templates
Writing concise executive summaries

use_cases.title: Multi-channel conversion attribution audit
use_cases.situation: Cross-channel campaign budgets are allocated based on fragmented last-touch attribution, obscuring the true influence of top-of-funnel channels.
workflow_steps: Extract multi-channel touchpoint paths and conversion records from GA4 into clean tabular format.
Load the dataset into Julius AI to calculate first-touch, linear, and data-driven attribution distributions.
Build interactive comparative visual charts in Power BI showing budget efficiency by channel.
Use Claude to draft plain-language scenario explanations for non-technical leadership.
Review statistical assumptions and validate findings with channel managers before budget reallocation.
use_cases.result: More balanced budget allocations across the marketing funnel backed by multi-model data.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Deliver a standalone "Channel Attribution & Media Spend Audit" for digital agencies.
guardrails: Anonymize all user identifiers and IP addresses before statistical modeling.
Human analysts must review all budget reallocation recommendations before capital deployment.
practice_skills: Interpreting attribution models in GA4 and Power BI
Conducting multi-variate statistical comparisons
Communicating data insights clearly to stakeholders

use_cases.title: Automated invoice line coding and vendor reconciliation
use_cases.situation: Processing hundreds of incoming supplier invoices each month requires repetitive manual data entry, leading to coding discrepancies and delayed approvals.
workflow_steps: Route digital vendor invoices into Vic.ai for automated OCR line extraction and general ledger code suggestions.
Review flagged confidence scores and verify tax calculation accuracy against supplier purchase orders.
Export reconciled transaction batches into Workiva for financial close schedule tracking.
Use ChatGPT to draft clarification emails to suppliers for any disputed invoice amounts.
Submit the approved batch to the financial controller for sign-off.
use_cases.result: Substantially reduced manual data entry time and fewer reconciliation discrepancies during month-end close.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Implement automated invoice processing setups for accounting firm clients.
guardrails: Require dual-human sign-off on all supplier banking details and payments exceeding corporate thresholds.
Ensure financial OCR systems strictly comply with enterprise data retention and privacy policies.
practice_skills: Auditing machine-coded general ledger allocations
Configuring automated invoice approval hierarchies
Resolving vendor billing discrepancies

use_cases.title: Quarterly budget variance analysis and commentary
use_cases.situation: Department heads struggle to explain line-item budget variances each quarter, leaving finance to draft commentary without adequate operational context.
workflow_steps: Consolidate planned vs actual expenditure in Anaplan and calculate percentage variances by cost center.
Use Formula Bot to generate dynamic spreadsheet formulas isolating departments exceeding variance thresholds.
Generate visual variance waterfall charts in Fathom for presentation decks.
Ask Claude to synthesize department manager interview notes into concise variance explanation paragraphs.
Review the final commentary with the financial director before board pack submission.
use_cases.result: Consistent, clear variance narratives delivered ahead of close deadlines.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Provide outsourced "Quarterly Financial Variance & Board Commentary" to mid-market firms.
guardrails: Cross-check all narrative numbers against certified accounting ledger balances.
Never share unmasked salary or proprietary cost data with public cloud models.
practice_skills: Operating financial planning software like Anaplan and Fathom
Designing automated variance calculation formulas
Synthesizing financial commentary for executives

use_cases.title: Inclusive job description optimization and candidate screening

workflow_steps: Review existing job description drafts in Textio to detect gendered language and exclusionary phrasing.
Use ChatGPT to brainstorm skill-based requirement alternatives focused on core outcomes rather than rigid credentials.
Publish the optimized role specification across career portals using Workable.
Utilize Eightfold AI to surface qualified passive candidates based on verified skills matching.
Human recruiters review shortlists and conduct initial phone screens before scheduling hiring manager interviews.
use_cases.result: Broader, more qualified applicant pools with objective competency evaluation criteria.
use_cases.freelance_angle: Offer clients an "Inclusive Job Architecture & Sourcing Strategy" package.
guardrails: All candidate evaluation criteria must be audited for compliance with employment regulations and equal opportunity standards.
Hiring decisions must always be made by human interview panels, never automated algorithms alone.
practice_skills: Evaluating job descriptions with Textio and readability tools
Setting up structured applicant pipelines in Workable
Managing candidate data under GDPR and employment regulations

use_cases.title: Tier-1 support ticket deflection and smart escalation
use_cases.situation: Support engineers spend over half their working hours answering repetitive password and billing inquiries, delaying responses to urgent technical bugs.
workflow_steps: Index verified product help docs and API guides with Kapa.ai and Intercom Fin.
Deploy automated conversation flows that answer routine billing and navigation questions immediately.
Configure Zendesk AI sentiment detection to automatically prioritize and escalate frustrated or VIP accounts.
